Elaine (CS): Heads-up — Solarflare renewal is in flight. Customer wants to move to a 24mo term and is asking for 10% credit for the first quarter due to last quarter's capacity hiccup.
Mike (AE): Do we have flexibility on 24mo? They mentioned Procurement prefers longer term for budgeting.
Olivia (Legal): Can we see the proposed amendment language? If we add credits we need an SOW or explicit credit clause. Send me the PO and draft.
Elaine (CS): PO's expected today. Draft amendment attached by the CS rep on call. Key ask: 24mo term, 10% credit applied to first invoice only, auto-renew after term.
Jared (Finance): For invoicing we need the PO number, company tax ID, and billing contact. Also, credits should be a line item on the invoice — our billing system can't do negative invoices.
Mike (AE): We can do a credit memo line instead. Also offering a one-time $5k onboarding credit instead of ongoing percent if that simplifies.
Olivia (Legal): I need the exact credit mechanics. Sample clause I'd accept:
```
If Customer experiences service degradation >5% of SLA in preceding quarter, Redwood will issue a one-time credit equal to 10% of the first invoice of the renewed term. Credits are non-recurring and applied as a credit memo on the invoice.
```
Olivia (Legal): Also request limiting language: "credit in lieu of termination or additional indemnities" — standard.
Elaine (CS): Solarflare says they'd prefer percent, procurement pushing 24mo & PO by EOD to hit fiscal close.
Jared (Finance): If PO arrives EOD we can do proforma invoice but final invoice needs signed amendment attached to billing.
esign-bot: Signature request sent to Solarflare via AdobeSign at 2026-02-14 16:22 UTC. Status: pending.
Mike (AE): If AdobeSign stalls, Customer will accept scanned signature + attached amendment to PO. Can we allow that as interim?
Olivia (Legal): We can accept scanned signed amendment as interim but need to ingest final e-signed copy within 5 business days.
Elaine (CS): Action items:
- Mike: confirm whether onboarding credit ($5k) vs 10% first invoice
- Jared: prepare proforma invoice with credit memo line and billing info template
- Olivia: attach amendment language and mark interim-scan acceptance
- I'll coordinate with Solarflare procurement and push for PO + signed scan

Mike (AE): I'll propose the $5k onboarding credit this afternoon; keeps accounting simple.
Jared (Finance): I'll draft proforma when Mike confirms. Need Customer legal billing contact email.
Elaine (CS): Solarflare billing contact: maria@solarflare.com. PO likely: PO-49821.
esign-bot: Reminder queued — if signature not received in 48h, escalate to Mike (AE).
Elaine (CS): Noted. Will ping here with PO and scanned amendment when I have it. :thumbsup:
